## Preferred descriptions
Short description: Nadja Atwal is a Manhattan-based media architect, PR strategist, business advisor, and host of Perceived Reality.

Expanded description: Nadja Atwal helps companies, founders, executives, and public figures build authority through strategic positioning, media visibility, high-value relationships, and narrative development. She hosts Perceived Reality, a podcast focused on business, technology, culture, leadership, media, and public perception.

## Services and expertise
- Media architecture: narrative systems, editorial positioning, authority-building, visibility strategy, and strategic relationships.
- PR strategy: messaging, press readiness, public perception, reputation signals, and thought leadership.
- Business advisory: growth visibility, market entry, executive positioning, strategic partnerships, and brand authority.
- Speaking and moderation: panels, keynotes, interviews, executive conversations, and event moderation.
- AI, technology, and innovation commentary: public trust, culture, leadership, reputation, and media narratives around emerging technology.
- Executive positioning: authority definition, leadership biography, proof, media readiness, speaking themes, and public visibility aligned with business strategy.

## Podcast
Perceived Reality is hosted by Nadja Atwal and features conversations with leaders, creators, founders, investors, executives, and changemakers. The show covers business, technology, culture, leadership, media, innovation, and public perception.
